summary:
Iteration 45 - PropertyPlug 'Auto-include new projects' + 'Co-owner profit split' feature end-to-end validation. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed covering (a) POST/PUT /api/co-owners + POST /api/co-owner-links accept auto_add; auto_add is stored only when project_ids is not null (unscoped co-owners get auto_add=False even if the client sent True), (b) PUT switching a scoped co-owner to project_ids=null correctly clears auto_add to False, (c) GET /api/co-owners returns the auto_add field, (d) accepting an invite link via POST /join/{token} persists auto_add on the resulting co_owners row, (e) POST /api/projects without add_co_owner_ids adds the new project id only to scoped co-owners/managers whose auto_add is True (plain scoped untouched, all-project co-owners never mutated), (f) POST /api/projects with add_co_owner_ids=[ids] adds exactly those scoped co-owners (and skips auto-add ones not listed), (g) POST /api/projects with add_co_owner_ids=[] adds none, (h) GET /api/project/split returns rows[0]=owner (is_owner=true, pct=100-sum(others)) followed by scoped co-owners/managers with per-person profit, monthly_rent, monthly_cashflow and annual_cashflow fields plus figures and can_edit, (i) PUT /api/project/split validation: single share >100 -> 400, negative -> 400, two shares summing >100 -> 400, unknown co_owner_id -> 400, (j) a scoped co-owner acting on the owner's project calling PUT /split -> 403 ('Only the project owner can change ownership shares'), (k) a tasks-only manager GET /split -> 403 (via block_money dependency). Frontend (390x844, demo@mybuilder.app on preview): /co-owners -- invite-auto-add chip is hidden when role=co_owner + 'All projects' and visible for co_owner+chosen AND for manager; a UI invite with scope=chosen+auto_add+one project produced a list card whose role label contains ' auto-adds new projects' (verified by scanning innerText); opening 'Change access' revealed edit-{cid}-auto-add chip. /project-edit?mode=new (reached from My projects new project) -- new-project-team section rendered with the scoped iter45auto co-owner row (new-project-team-{id}) visually pre-ticked (orange checkbox filled with check icon per screenshot) and the label 'Co-owner . Nottingham Victorian Refurb . auto-ad...'; new-project-team-all section is only shown when all-project co-owners exist (correctly suppressed here because demo had none). Home screen -- for a BRRR project with at least one scoped co-owner: scrolled below the Rentals card to find split-card (visible), split-row-owner with split-pct-owner=100% and split-empty message 'You own 100%. Tap Edit to give co-owners a share of profit and rent.' when has_split=false; Edit opens split-input-{coid}; typing 150 triggers split-over 'Shares add up to more than 100%' and the split-save button is aria-disabled=true; changing to 25 clears the warning; saving updates split-pct-owner to 75% and split-pct-{coid} to 25%. PDF ownership split (code review of /app/frontend/src/report.ts): progressBody() fetches /project/split (catches to null so tasks-only managers still get a report), buildHtml() invokes splitHtml(split) which returns '' when !split || !split.has_split, otherwise emits

Ownership split

+ a table of Owner/Share/Profit(if present)/Rent/mo/Cashflow/mo/Cashflow/yr for every row plus a formula footnote - correct against the spec. Cleanup: all iter45* co_owners, co_owner_links and test projects deleted by test_zzz_cleanup; the extra UI invite (iter45ui@example.com + iter45auto@example.com) removed via the UI remove-confirm flow; stale iter44 joiner user and the orphan ownership_shares row created during the split save test were wiped via cleanup_iter45.py; the demo's original 'Nottingham Victorian Refurb' project was re-activated.
action_items: No code changes required. Auto-include new projects + per-project ownership split are correct end-to-end on preview.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/co_owners.py:39-45 _access() correctly stores auto_add=True only when project_ids is not None (`body.auto_add and body.project_ids is not None`) - verified for POST, PUT and co_owner-link creation.

routes/co_owners.py:228-229 accept_link() preserves auto_add from the link doc into the new co_owners row via `auto_add: bool(d.get('auto_add'))` - verified by two-user register+join integration test.

routes/projects.py:265-271 create_project filters scoped co-owners (project_ids: {$ne: None}) and switches between auto_add-filter vs id-filter based on whether add_co_owner_ids is None; unscoped (all-project) co-owners are never touched; empty list correctly adds none (edge case tested).
routes/ownership.py:16-21 _people() returns scoped+unscoped co-owners that have access to the given pid - matches split rows definition in spec.

routes/ownership.py:32-42 get_split() computes owner_pct = 100 - sum(others) and populates per-row profit, monthly_rent, monthly_cashflow, annual_cashflow correctly; can_edit=user.real_id is None (owner only).
routes/ownership.py:50-63 save_split() validates: non-owner -> 403, unknown co_owner_id -> 400, each share 0..100 -> 400, sum>100 -> 400, stores only positive rounded shares - all verified.
routes/ownership.py:13 router has `dependencies=[Depends(block_money)]` so tasks-only managers get 403 on GET /project/split and PUT - verified end-to-end.

frontend/src/components/ownership-split-card.tsx:27 `if (!d || d.rows.length < 2) return null;` correctly hides the card for projects with no co-owners (prevents a lonely 'you own 100%' card on every project).

frontend/src/components/new-project-team-picker.tsx:21-27 useEffect pre-ticks only scoped co-owners with auto_add on; everyone-with-all-projects is shown as a muted text sentence (not a checkbox) - matches spec.

frontend/src/report.ts:143-151 splitHtml() renders ownership split section only when has_split is true; profit column is optional based on figures.profit; integrated via progressBody() with .catch(() => null) so tasks-only managers (403) don't break the progress PDF.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all 10+ UI assertions verified on preview (invite-auto-add visibility matrix, auto-adds label on list card, edit-{cid}-auto-add, new-project-team pre-tick, split-card visibility, split-empty, split-row-owner, split-pct-owner, split-input, split-over warning, split-save disable, save mutation reflects pct)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created ~7 co_owners (iter45*@example.com), 1 co_owner_link, 1 joiner user, 1 scoped manager user, 3 test projects; test_zzz_cleanup removed them all. Frontend UI tests created 2 co-owners (iter45ui@example.com, iter45auto@example.com) + 1 ownership_shares doc; all removed via the UI remove-confirm flow and cleanup_iter45.py. Demo account restored to the original 'Nottingham Victorian Refurb' as active project.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scoped co-owners now carry an auto_add flag. On /co-owners the invite-auto-add Chip exists only when the invitee gets a chosen-project scope (role=co_owner+Chosen OR role=manager). The co-owner list card appends ' . auto-adds new projects' to the role line when auto_add is true. On /project-edit?mode=new a NewProjectTeamPicker lists chosen-project co-owners with checkboxes (new-project-team-{id}, pre-ticked when auto_add=true) and a muted sentence for all-project co-owners (new-project-team-all). On the home money summary (BRRR/investment projects) OwnershipSplitCard renders split-card -> split-edit -> split-input-{coid} -> split-save/split-cancel/split-over/split-pct-* flow; the card hides entirely when the project has no co-owners (rows<2). PDF: /app/frontend/src/report.ts splitHtml() integrates into progressBody - correctly behind has_split flag. React Native Web NOTE: Pressable with accessibilityRole='checkbox' + accessibilityState={{checked}} currently renders role='checkbox' but no aria-checked attribute in the DOM; visual tick (filled brand-colored box + check icon) is reliable - prefer checking the inner <svg> or the component's child styling instead of aria-checked for Pressable-based checkboxes in future tests.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all features correct. Backend 19/19 pass, frontend all assertions pass, PDF code review clean.
